_comment: Template for ~/.claude/settings.json. Merge into an existing file rather than overwriting it — an existing settings.json may hold machine-specific permissions worth keeping. The permissions.allow list is deliberately EMPTY: allowlists should grow from real prompts on this machine, never be inherited (see EXCLUDED.md).
_statusLine_comment: Live context gauge + this session's weighted token burn. Context is re-read on EVERY turn, so cost scales with (context size x turns) — with no instrument a session drifts from a ~90k baseline to 260k+ and every trivial reply starts costing ~26k weighted tokens before it thinks a word. The built-in corner indicator is too passive to notice mid-task; this sits in front of you on every turn.

PostToolUse._comment: Task-boundary nudge: suggests /clear at the one moment it is free — right after a commit/PR/merge/push has banked the work AND context is already expensive. Fires on both conditions or not at all; a nudge that fires on every threshold crossing becomes wallpaper, which is exactly how the passive indicator stopped being read.

skillOverrides._comment: Turn OFF skills that duplicate a preferred one or that fire unwanted. Keeping the listing lean is what makes the right skill get picked. Populate this as skills prove noisy on this machine; the entries below are the categories worth watching, not a prescription.

enabledPlugins._comment: Public marketplace plugins. Install with: claude plugin install <id>. The `false` entries are kept deliberately rather than deleted — they record which plugins were evaluated and switched OFF, so the decision survives. Every enabled plugin spends context on skill listings whether or not it is ever used; trimming this map from 27 enabled to the set below recovered ~30k tokens of listing per session. Re-enabling is one flag, so bias toward off.
